description:
We’re looking for an Analytics Developer to own the technical backbone of our Revenue Intelligence & Analytics team. You’ll keep our Microsoft Fabric pipelines and Power BI models running and trusted, and you’ll build the apps and automations that take manual work off the Sales Operations team.
  
 This is a hands-on build role. You’ll start by owning our daily data refresh pipeline, then take on a growing share of internal application development using modern, AI-assisted tools. As the team grows, there is a clear path to a Senior or BI Lead role.
  
 Key Responsibilities 
   
 Data Pipelines & Platform Operations 
 Own the daily Microsoft Fabric refresh pipeline: scheduling, monitoring, and recovery when source systems run late
 Partner with the database and IT teams to track upstream delays and pause or rerun refreshes as data comes online
 Maintain Power BI semantic models and dataflows, including performance, row-level security, and refresh reliability
 Document pipelines, models, and data definitions, and contribute to the Sales Operations SOP library, so the team has a clear map of what data feeds what
  
 Applications & Automation Development 
 Help build internal Fabric apps and automations (e.g., territory management, bonus administration) that replace manual Sales Operations work
 Use version control, separate dev/test/prod environments, and peer review so what we ship is supportable
  
 Dashboard Development & Business Intelligence 
 Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports used by sales leadership, regional managers, and operations stakeholders
 Translate business questions into analytical solutions: defining data models, DAX measures, and visual layouts that surface actionable insight
 Own the full lifecycle of each BI deliverable: requirements gathering, development, QA, stakeholder review, and ongoing maintenance
 Proactively identify opportunities to consolidate, retire, or automate legacy reports that no longer serve a decision-making function
 Maintain a data quality scorecard tracking duplicate rates, missing fields, and stale records across key data sources, with periodic reporting to leadership
  
 Sales Reporting & Process Improvement 
 Identify, propose, and help implement process improvements for manual or inefficient workflows within the sales operations function
 Automate routine sales reports, pipeline views, territory summaries, and order recaps so reps and managers get reliable, consistent data
 Support ad-hoc analytical requests from sales leadership, providing clean, well-documented outputs with appropriate context and caveats
  
 Requirements 
 1+ years of experience in a BI, analytics development, or data engineering role, including something you have owned in production (a pipeline, scheduled job, or data model)
 Hands-on Power BI experience including report and dashboard development, DAX measures, and data modeling
 Working SQL skills: joins, window functions, and troubleshooting slow or broken queries
 Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or a comparable platform (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Snowflake)
 Experience with Git or another version control tool
 Organized and self-directed; able to manage multiple recurring workflows and project deliverables without close supervision
 Experience working with CRM or ERP data (Microsoft Dynamics or SAP preferred)
 Comfort with data quality concepts e.g. duplicate records, missing fields, metric tie-outs
 Clear communicator who can translate analytical outputs for non-technical stakeholders across Sales, Finance, and IT
  
 Nice to Have 
 Python or PySpark for data transformation and automation
 Experience with SAP, Snowflake, IBM Cognos, or similar enterprise ERP and reporting environments
 Familiarity with Power Automate or similar workflow automation tools
 Experience building apps or automations with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)
 Pay Range: 
$60,000.00 USD - $85,000.00 USD Annually 


 What We Offer 
 A commitment that Safety is #1
 Competitive benefits including: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
 401(k) with company match
 Paid time off and paid holidays
 Life and disability insurance
 
 Career growth, stability, and flexible work arrangements.
 
 Responsible Manufacturing – Protecting Our Planet for the Future 
 We utilize renewable energy and a closed loop recycled water process.
 We are committed to reducing greenhouse emissions and water consumption.
 We are the only flooring company recognized by the Asthma and Allergy foundation.
 
 Who we are: 
 With a history of more than 140 years, Tarkett is a worldwide leader in innovative and sustainable flooring and sport surface solutions, generating turnover of €3.3 billion in 2025. The Group has close to 12,000 employees, 25 R&D centers, 8 recycling centers and 33 production sites. Tarkett creates and manufactures solutions for hospitals, schools, housing, hotels, offices, stores and sports fields, serving customers in over 100 countries. To build “The Way to Better Floors,” the Group is committed to circular economy and sustainability, in line with its Tarkett Human ‐ Conscious Design® approach. 

 www.tarkett-group.com 

 Tarkett is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity in backgrounds and in experiences and promote an inclusive workplace where all employees can perform at their best.
